g.text: Synthetic Sentinel-1-like chips: K-distributed sea clutter (shape 1.5), ships 2–7 pixels long at 3–20 dB above the clutter, and look-alikes (azimuth
ghosts, breaking-wave spikes). Training: 12 000 chips with flips and rotations; test: 6 000 ships and 30 000 negatives. CA-CFAR: brightest 2 × 2 mean
